description: Circle of the Moon Druids are fierce warriors who channel their wild shape to become powerful animal forms in combat.

features.name: Combat Wild Shape
features.description: Your wild shape bonus action can be used more frequently. You can also add your proficiency bonus to damage rolls in beast form.

features.name: Lunar Step
features.description: When you cast a spell with a range of Self, you can use a bonus action to move up to your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Primal Strike
features.description: Your beast form's unarmed strike count as magical for overcoming resistance.

features.name: Moonlit Form
features.description: Your wild shape forms gain temporary hit points equal to your Druid level when you assume the form.
